Class AppShell

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.view.AppShell
public class AppShell extends Object
The application frame every screen plugs into. It owns the window and the sidebar, and swaps only the centre content when a nav item is clicked, so pages never redraw the sidebar themselves. Register pages with add(Page) then call show().

How a teammate adds their screen: implement Page and add it in Main — new AppShell(stage).add(new MyView()) ... .show();

It also hosts the reminder strip along the top, so a due reminder is visible from any screen rather than only from the Schedule page. See withReminders(Supplier).

    • withReminders

      public AppShell withReminders(Supplier<List<ScheduledWorkout>> source)
      Turns on the reminder strip, fed by source every 30 seconds.

      The poll runs on the JavaFX application thread on purpose. The whole app shares one SQLite Connection, and using a shared connection from a background thread at the same time as a button handler is a data race. The query is a single indexed read of one user's schedule, so it costs well under a frame. Moving this onto a background Task would first need a connection per thread, or a lock around every DAO call.

      US-23 — See due reminders.

      Parameters:
      source - supplies the current user's schedule; return an empty list when nobody is signed in

    • onLogout
